name: Takashiro Shuugo
source:
A private detective based in Ueno. Used to work with [url=/c4078]Reiji[/url] and [url=/c4084]Uozumi[/url] and still helps out his friends when needed. [spoiler]Married to [url=/c4087]Kazuna[/url], a former client with whom he shares a lot of history. Since she's currently pregnant, Shugo focuses on less dangerous tasks like investigating cheating spouses and searching for people in order to worry her less.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=79]MangaGamer[/url]]

He is the younger brother of [url=/c4088]Natsume[/url], and older brother of [url=/c16800]Nana[/url].
